title: Towards Better Agents for Multi-Turn User Interaction: The Next User Turn Is More Than Context
abstract: arXiv:2608.17499v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User-facing tool agents must coordinate dialogue and tool use as user goals unfold over multiple turns. Yet interactive reinforcement learning typically reduces each rollout to a terminal reward, assigning the same credit to effective elicitation, errors, and later repair. The next user turn is more than context: it also provides noisy, temporally local evidence about the preceding user-to-user segment. We introduce \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{C}redit \textbf{A}ssignment (\textsc{FACA}), which aligns each reaction with that segment, derives a locally normalized reaction advantage, and adds it to verified terminal outcome advantage without an extra critic or rollout. translated_title: 面向多轮用户交互的更优智能体：下一轮用户输入不仅仅是上下文
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17499v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：面向用户的工具智能体必须在多轮交互中协调对话与工具使用，因为用户目标会逐步展开。然而，交互式强化学习通常将每次回合格化为单一终端奖励，对有效的引导、错误及后续修复赋予相同的信用。下一轮用户输入不仅仅是上下文：它还提供了关于前一轮用户到用户片段的有噪声、时间上局部的证据。我们引入了**反馈感知信用分配**（\textsc{FACA}），该方法将每个反应与该片段对齐，推导出局部归一化的反应优势，并将其与验证过的终端结果优势相加，无需额外的评论家或回滚。在与仅基于结果的交互式GRPO控制组（在模拟器、可见对话、初始化、回滚和优化方面均匹配）的对比中，\textsc{FACA}在三个独立训练运行中提升了九领域τ家族平均性能，分别提高了5.91和10.22个百分点。
tldr: 本文提出反馈感知信用分配（FACA）方法，利用下一轮用户输入作为局部反馈信号，在不增加额外计算开销的情况下，显著提升多轮交互工具智能体的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Feedback-Aware Credit Assignment (FACA), which leverages the next user turn as local feedback signals to improve multi-turn interactive tool agents' performance without extra computational overhead.
